competences.description: Attacks all enemies and weakens their Attack Power for 1 turn with a 50% chance. This attack ignores all effects that resist death.

The Attack Power and Defense increases by 25% for each beneficial effect granted on the Ancient Guardian, and the HP is recovered in proportion to the Attack Power at the start of each turn. [Automatic Effect]
Attacks all enemies 2 times, and each attack has a 50% chance to put them in Oblivion state for 2 turns. The damage increases by 10% for each harmful effect granted on the enemies.
Attacks the enemy 3 times to inflict damage that ignores the target's Defense. Grants an effect that increases the Ancient Guardian's Attack Power for 2 turns afterwards.
